lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A voice carries from the tree line, flat and unhurried.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Take the woman alive if you can. The sword comes back whatever it costs.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: And the one fighting beside her. {They} {has|have} seen too much now.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: That voice. He has hunted me since the mountains.

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: He will not come out while his hunters still stand. Cut them down.
